# Create an HCP Virtual Network

A HashiCorp Virtual Network (HVN) is a logical representation of a subnet in
AWS that defines a IPv4 CIDR block. The platform uses this CIDR range to
automatically create a virtual private cloud (VPC).

## Requirements

- The CIDR block value must be a private IPv4 CIDR block within the 
  [RFC1918](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1918) address space.
- A CIDR block value must end between /16 and /25.
- CIDR block names must be unique within a project.
- You can create a maxiumum of 5 HVNs within an organization.
- HVN CIDR blocks should not overlap with your external networks CIDR blocks (e.g AWS, Azure).
